description.value: First Tracks Lodge is an upscale ski-in/ski-out hotel in Whistler's Creekside neighbourhood, offering spacious designer suites ranging from one to four bedrooms, each with full kitchens. The property sits at the base of the Whistler Gondola and features four-season pools, hot tubs, and a lobby library, making it one of the more refined lodging options in Creekside. Touring cyclists visiting Whistler's world-class trail network would find it a quiet, well-appointed base away from the bustle of Whistler Village.
